mechanism_narrative: The consistent upward trend in workplace attendance over the past four weeks indicates a sustained return to office routines, which will drive an increase in associated retail and recreation activities during weekdays over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the mean of the last 28 days, despite WORKPLACES continuing its upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rebound in transit station activity, as observed in the last week, suggests a renewed willingness for public movement and commuting, which will translate into higher retail and recreation engagement over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by more than 3 points week-on-week
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not show an increase in the next 14 days following a week-on-week rise in TRANSIT greater than 3 points.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous increase in workplace attendance and decrease in residential time indicates a strong shift away from home-based activities, freeing up time and opportunity for out-of-home retail and recreation, driving an increase over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the previous 28 days, despite WORKPLACES rising and RESIDENTIAL falling concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: The recent rebound in parks mobility, following a dip, suggests a return to favorable weather conditions or a seasonal increase in outdoor activities, which often correlates with increased foot traffic in nearby retail and recreation areas over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 28 days, despite a significant week-on-week rise in PARKS mobility during a period of favorable weather.

mechanism_narrative: The sustained decrease in time spent at residential locations over the past four weeks indicates a broader shift towards out-of-home activities, which will directly contribute to an increase in retail and recreation mobility over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the mean of the last 28 days, despite RESIDENTIAL continuing its downward trend.

mechanism_narrative: A continued decline in grocery and pharmacy visits suggests that essential errands are being completed less frequently or are less of a priority, freeing up time and disposable income for non-essential retail and recreation activities over the next one week.

failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not increase in the next 7 days following a week-on-week drop in GROCERY_PHARM greater than 0.2 points.

mechanism_narrative: The combined recent increases in both transit usage and workplace attendance signify a robust return to daily routines involving commuting and out-of-home presence, which will inevitably boost retail and recreation mobility over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than the previous 14 days, despite both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES showing recent upward trends.

mechanism_narrative: The recent upward momentum in RETAIL_REC, moving from -7.7% to -7.0% in the last week, indicates a positive shift in consumer confidence and activity, suggesting this trend will continue and drive further increases over the next one week.
